crossRefs.note: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’ ”
But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”
Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with…
Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.

translations.web: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
translations.bsb: If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the battle and never repeat it!
translations.kjv: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
translations.asv: Lay thy hand upon him; Remember the battle, and do so no more.
